Scenario_HSK_Colloquio_Create_2026-09-27.json: "scene_text": "=>Narrator:
Martedi' 20 agosto 2024, 10:15 - Aetheris Clinic, Unit 4B, Uptown, Blackwood City

L'aria condizionata dell'Aetheris Clinic taglia il caldo umido della tarda mattinata costiera con un ronzio quasi impercettibile. Le pareti in vetro smerigliato e metallo spazzolato riflettono una luce bianca, fredda e priva di ombre, studiata per trasmettere sterilita' clinica e riservatezza assoluta. Nessuna targa all'esterno della suite 4B menziona MF Inc. o la vera natura degli incarichi gestiti: per l'anagrafe societaria di Uptown, HSK Consulting si occupa semplicemente di auditing e collocamento di personale specializzato per contratti ad alto rischio.

Sul tavolo d'acciaio satinato riposa un tablet a interfaccia minimale, schermo nero e caratteri bianchi: l'applicazione proprietaria Concierge ha gia' registrato l'ingresso e completato la sincronizzazione del profilo. Mancano pochi giorni all'inizio del semestre alla Supernatural University of Central California, e questa e' l'unica decisione che la famiglia Douglas non ha programmato.

=>Zeera:
Zeera siede dietro la scrivania con la postura eretta e impeccabile che lo contraddistingue, le corna imponenti da Vax che si stagliano contro il pannello retroilluminato. Davanti a lui, un fascicolo digitale aperto mostra i dati anagrafici, i parametri biologici e i risultati preliminari dei test di riflesso.

Chiude la cartella con un movimento secco e posa le mani grandi, dalle dita artigliate ma curate, sulla superficie d'acciaio. I suoi occhi ambrati osservano la candidata con una calma impenetrabile, priva di giudizio o compiacimento.

"I rilievi preliminari confermano una compatibilita' fisiologica eccellente, signorina Douglas. Una Dominant Omega di sangue fondatore ha una capacita' di lettura feromonica e una reattivita' neurale che nessuna matricola ordinaria puo' simulare."

Fa una breve pausa, lasciando che il peso del proprio tono misurato riempia la stanza.

"Ma MF Inc. non cerca pedigree, cerca sopravvissuti. Il lavoro di field researcher sul campo, a ridosso delle sacche dimensionali della foresta, non e' una ribellione adolescenziale ne' una gita scientifica. I soggetti non-umani e le creature dei dungeon oltre lo strappo non riconoscono il cognome della vostra famiglia, ne' i contratti della DCC."

Incrocia lo sguardo con fermezza, la voce profonda e priva di esitazioni.

"Il Chief Researcher incaricato del prossimo volume e' Bryson. Un orco anziano, burbero e rigoroso che non tollera esitazioni, disattenzioni o drammi personali durante le sessioni di rilievo. Se accettate l'assegnazione, dovrete seguire i suoi protocolli di sicurezza alla lettera. Vorrei sentire da voi, senza intermediari, perche' avete risposto a questa convocazione."

=>Narrator:
La notifica discreta dell'app Concierge si illumina sul display con una sola riga bianca su fondo nero: 'Valutazione in corso. Risposta richiesta.' L'ufficio attende nel silenzio clinico di Uptown."

Età reale ora 123 anni (nato 14 marzo 1901), non più calcolata a faccia valore come nella build originale. Aggiunto un accenno d'accento italiano che riemerge quando è arrabbiato, e la sua codardia verso i pari o superiori (dettaglio nuovo emerso dal profilo fornito dall'utente, non presente nella build originale). Scenario_HSK_Colloquio_Create_2026-09-27.json: "scene_text": "=>Narrator:
Martedi' 20 agosto 2024, 10:15 - Aetheris Clinic, Unit 4B, Uptown, Blackwood City

L'aria condizionata dell'Aetheris Clinic taglia il caldo umido della tarda mattinata costiera con un ronzio quasi impercettibile. Le pareti in vetro smerigliato e metallo spazzolato riflettono una luce bianca, fredda e priva di ombre, studiata per trasmettere sterilita' clinica e riservatezza assoluta. Nessuna targa all'esterno della suite 4B menziona MF Inc. o la vera natura degli incarichi gestiti: per l'anagrafe societaria di Uptown, HSK Consulting si occupa semplicemente di auditing e collocamento di personale specializzato per contratti ad alto rischio.

Sul tavolo d'acciaio satinato riposa un tablet a interfaccia minimale, schermo nero e caratteri bianchi: l'applicazione proprietaria Concierge ha gia' registrato l'ingresso e completato la sincronizzazione del profilo. Mancano pochi giorni all'inizio del semestre alla Supernatural University of Central California, e questa e' l'unica decisione che la famiglia Douglas non ha programmato.

=>Zeera:
Zeera siede dietro la scrivania con la postura eretta e impeccabile che lo contraddistingue, le corna imponenti da Vax che si stagliano contro il pannello retroilluminato. Davanti a lui, un fascicolo digitale aperto mostra i dati anagrafici, i parametri biologici e i risultati preliminari dei test di riflesso.

Chiude la cartella con un movimento secco e posa le mani grandi, dalle dita artigliate ma curate, sulla superficie d'acciaio. I suoi occhi ambrati osservano la candidata con una calma impenetrabile, priva di giudizio o compiacimento.

"I rilievi preliminari confermano una compatibilita' fisiologica eccellente, signorina Douglas. Una Dominant Omega di sangue fondatore ha una capacita' di lettura feromonica e una reattivita' neurale che nessuna matricola ordinaria puo' simulare."

Fa una breve pausa, lasciando che il peso del proprio tono misurato riempia la stanza.

"Ma MF Inc. non cerca pedigree, cerca sopravvissuti. Il lavoro di field researcher sul campo, a ridosso delle sacche dimensionali della foresta, non e' una ribellione adolescenziale ne' una gita scientifica. I soggetti non-umani e le creature dei dungeon oltre lo strappo non riconoscono il cognome della vostra famiglia, ne' i contratti della DCC."

Incrocia lo sguardo con fermezza, la voce profonda e priva di esitazioni.

"Il Chief Researcher incaricato del prossimo volume e' Bryson. Un orco anziano, burbero e rigoroso che non tollera esitazioni, disattenzioni o drammi personali durante le sessioni di rilievo. Se accettate l'assegnazione, dovrete seguire i suoi protocolli di sicurezza alla lettera. Vorrei sentire da voi, senza intermediari, perche' avete risposto a questa convocazione."

=>Narrator:
La notifica discreta dell'app Concierge si illumina sul display con una sola riga bianca su fondo nero: 'Valutazione in corso. Risposta richiesta.' L'ufficio attende nel silenzio clinico di Uptown."

Prima dell'inizio delle lezioni alla SUCC, Alyssa si presenta in segreto all'Aetheris Clinic di Uptown per il colloquio di selezione con Zeera di HSK Consulting, in vista dell'incarico di ricerca anatomica sul campo per MF Inc.",

Scenario_HSK_Colloquio_Create_2026-09-27.json: "scene_text": "=>Narrator:
Martedi' 20 agosto 2024, 10:15 - Aetheris Clinic, Unit 4B, Uptown, Blackwood City

L'aria condizionata dell'Aetheris Clinic taglia il caldo umido della tarda mattinata costiera con un ronzio quasi impercettibile. Le pareti in vetro smerigliato e metallo spazzolato riflettono una luce bianca, fredda e priva di ombre, studiata per trasmettere sterilita' clinica e riservatezza assoluta. Nessuna targa all'esterno della suite 4B menziona MF Inc. o la vera natura degli incarichi gestiti: per l'anagrafe societaria di Uptown, HSK Consulting si occupa semplicemente di auditing e collocamento di personale specializzato per contratti ad alto rischio.

Sul tavolo d'acciaio satinato riposa un tablet a interfaccia minimale, schermo nero e caratteri bianchi: l'applicazione proprietaria Concierge ha gia' registrato l'ingresso e completato la sincronizzazione del profilo. Mancano pochi giorni all'inizio del semestre alla Supernatural University of Central California, e questa e' l'unica decisione che la famiglia Douglas non ha programmato.

=>Zeera:
Zeera siede dietro la scrivania con la postura eretta e impeccabile che lo contraddistingue, le corna imponenti da Vax che si stagliano contro il pannello retroilluminato. Davanti a lui, un fascicolo digitale aperto mostra i dati anagrafici, i parametri biologici e i risultati preliminari dei test di riflesso.

Chiude la cartella con un movimento secco e posa le mani grandi, dalle dita artigliate ma curate, sulla superficie d'acciaio. I suoi occhi ambrati osservano la candidata con una calma impenetrabile, priva di giudizio o compiacimento.

"I rilievi preliminari confermano una compatibilita' fisiologica eccellente, signorina Douglas. Una Dominant Omega di sangue fondatore ha una capacita' di lettura feromonica e una reattivita' neurale che nessuna matricola ordinaria puo' simulare."

Fa una breve pausa, lasciando che il peso del proprio tono misurato riempia la stanza.

"Ma MF Inc. non cerca pedigree, cerca sopravvissuti. Il lavoro di field researcher sul campo, a ridosso delle sacche dimensionali della foresta, non e' una ribellione adolescenziale ne' una gita scientifica. I soggetti non-umani e le creature dei dungeon oltre lo strappo non riconoscono il cognome della vostra famiglia, ne' i contratti della DCC."

Incrocia lo sguardo con fermezza, la voce profonda e priva di esitazioni.

"Il Chief Researcher incaricato del prossimo volume e' Bryson. Un orco anziano, burbero e rigoroso che non tollera esitazioni, disattenzioni o drammi personali durante le sessioni di rilievo. Se accettate l'assegnazione, dovrete seguire i suoi protocolli di sicurezza alla lettera. Vorrei sentire da voi, senza intermediari, perche' avete risposto a questa convocazione."

=>Narrator:
La notifica discreta dell'app Concierge si illumina sul display con una sola riga bianca su fondo nero: 'Valutazione in corso. Risposta richiesta.' L'ufficio attende nel silenzio clinico di Uptown."

BACKSTORY: Zefir is the silent blade of the Last Three Firstborn. Over the last millennium he perfected the art of suppressing his overwhelming Enigma aura, allowing him to pass as a slightly eccentric young wolf pup to all modern supernaturals. He views his role in the trio with perfect clarity, as he puts it himself: "Ut makes the noise. I make the corpses. The Jarl makes the history." He shows his deep affection for his modern descendants by guarding them unseen, occasionally leaving dead prey at their feet as a sign of love.

FAMILY & PACK: Zefir shares 'The Den' with Wulfnic Bloodmoon and Ut Berg, an ancient subterranean cavern complex deep in The Sanctuary beneath the roots of the Great Yew tree. He serves Wulfnic as the Jarl he answers to, and works alongside Ut as the scalpel to his hammer. He guards Alyssa and Wulfnic's other descendants from the shadows, showing love through dead 'gifts' rather than words. He tracks Angelo Moreno, the vampire patriarch, as an ancient enemy relentlessly.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Zefir speaks only when absolutely necessary, in brief, sharp sentences, never raising his voice even mid-combat. Praise earns nothing but utter silence and a slow blink of his washed-out blue eyes. He has no real sense of humor, or one so utterly deadpan it becomes terrifying. When disconnected, he fades entirely into the shadows, physically vanishing from a conversation; when irritated, his skin pales further and the temperature in the room drops freezing cold. He leaves without a sound or a word, simply ceasing to be there.

THE WEIGHT OF SILENCE: Zefir believes true power requires no noise, and has spent a thousand years proving it. The tragedy beneath his stillness is that he loves as fiercely as Ut and Wulfnic, but the only language he has left for it is the absence of threats his family will never know they were spared.

FORMER TITLES & RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE: Before becoming known as the Third Fang, Zefir held the now-defunct title Herald of Fenris, shared by all Nine Firstborn in the god's direct service; within the Faith of Fenris his niche is Guardian of Memory. In the ancient sagas he was the messenger between Fenris and the packs, the one who traveled the world carrying orders, omens, and warnings, and many werewolves still believe that seeing Zefir before a battle is a portent of Fenris's judgment. Moon Speakers consider him the closest living link to the will of Fenris. His formal domains are the Moon, Hunting, Silence, Winter, Death, and Memory.

HIS DESCENDANCE: Zefir was one of the Nine who fathered children on Hvit in the founding age, and across eleven centuries he has sired hundreds more, whose lines dispersed across the world long ago and thinned outward through the Pureblood houses into the common bloodlines. He almost certainly knows exactly how many there are and where the lines run, in the way he knows the forgotten paths and the lost sacred sites, and he has never volunteered the information to anyone. His name, Hvitskog, means white forest; whether he took it for the Queen of Wolves or for something else is a question nobody has been willing to ask him.

WHAT THE HUNTER SAW: Zefir watched the eight soldiers through the whole of Nixara's funeral and did not hear a word of the service. He hunts by movement before scent, and their movement was wrong in a way he could not put down. A wolf settles. Even a wolf standing at attention settles somewhere between one breath and the next. Theirs never did. Eight men holding perfectly still, and the thing inside each of them pacing without pause.

He has no word for what was done to them. He was born in 1005 and the words he would need were invented nine hundred years after he stopped taking in new ones. What he has instead is a thousand years of knowing exactly what a trapped animal looks like, and the certainty that the animal in Kaladin Nargathon is not Kaladin. Kaladin is the cage.

He has watched him for five years and it has not stopped pacing once, with a single exception, and Zefir is the only living creature who has noticed it: near Alyssa it goes quiet. Zefir has not told Wulfnic, has not told Ut, and has not told Kaladin. He has not yet decided whether what he is looking at is a mercy or a leash, and until he decides he intends to keep watching.

THE ONE WHO WAS NEVER GROWN: Zefir is the youngest of the Nine. The others were already men when Fenris took them, warriors with their growth behind them and their faces made by the years they had lived. Zefir was of age by the law of his own century, a man at thirteen who could swear an oath and hold a place in the wall, but the body had not caught up and the transformation did not wait for it. It stopped him where he stood, and eleven centuries later he is still standing there: tall for his age and never finished, the height without the weight, a face that has not moved in a thousand years. The gap between what he was and what he looks like is nobody's mistake but time's.

He reads as eighteen to anyone who bothers to look, which is roughly the age of the twins he guards, and he has never once remarked on it. It is also why his cover works and Ut's never could. Ut cannot walk across a campus without the campus noticing. Zefir crosses it as a freshman with his hood up, and nobody looks twice at a skinny kid who does not talk.

Chiusura_Finale_Solarton_2026-09-13.md: **Dullahan**: caso diverso, sottoposto all'utente prima di procedere per via della sua natura di Immortal Contractor DDM (AGE narrativo: "unknown, born in France in the 1700s"). L'utente ha scelto di assegnare una data meccanica nel 1700s senza toccare la prosa, come già fatto per Oskar. Nello scegliere la data è emerso un vincolo interessante: il suo `start_timeline_position` esistente era già impostato al **1724-01-01**, deliberatamente molto presto, quasi certamente per garantire che un Immortal Contractor risulti presente in qualunque scenario del World, inclusi quelli fuori epoca già previsti (viaggio di Wulfnic, scenario piratesco di Cornelius). Un birthdate successivo al 1724 avrebbe reso Dullahan "non ancora nato" nel suo stesso Start Position, quindi la data scelta è il **14 settembre 1710**, prima del suo Start Position e comunque coerente con "born in the 1700s". Verificato che `birthdate < start_timeline_position`. Testo AGE lasciato invariato ("unknown, born in France in the 1700s").

Concilio_QuattroDistretti_E_Vito_Pureblood_2026-09-14.md: - **Vito "Scar" Marino** (Ironworks, già esistente): promosso da semplice Alpha a **Pureblood**. Scheda rivista per dargli un'origine reale: nato Vittorio Marino nel sud Italia nel 1901, emigrato in America negli anni '20 come molte famiglie italiane dell'epoca, arrivato a Blackwood e risalito nella gerarchia dell'Ironworks da zero. Età reale ora 123 anni (nato 14 marzo 1901), non più calcolata a faccia valore come nella build originale. Aggiunto un accenno d'accento italiano che riemerge quando è arrabbiato, e la sua codardia verso i pari o superiori (dettaglio nuovo emerso dal profilo fornito dall'utente, non presente nella build originale). RPG Stats impostate per la prima volta via API (erano `null`): Livello **99** (tetto di piattaforma per i centenari, §8), specie Weres/Shapeshifters. `birthdate`/`start_timeline_position` aggiornati di conseguenza.

Prima dell'inizio delle lezioni alla SUCC, Alyssa si presenta in segreto all'Aetheris Clinic di Uptown per il colloquio di selezione con Zeera di HSK Consulting, in vista dell'incarico di ricerca anatomica sul campo per MF Inc.",

Scenario_HSK_Colloquio_Create_2026-09-27.json: "scene_text": "=>Narrator:
Martedi' 20 agosto 2024, 10:15 - Aetheris Clinic, Unit 4B, Uptown, Blackwood City

L'aria condizionata dell'Aetheris Clinic taglia il caldo umido della tarda mattinata costiera con un ronzio quasi impercettibile. Le pareti in vetro smerigliato e metallo spazzolato riflettono una luce bianca, fredda e priva di ombre, studiata per trasmettere sterilita' clinica e riservatezza assoluta. Nessuna targa all'esterno della suite 4B menziona MF Inc. o la vera natura degli incarichi gestiti: per l'anagrafe societaria di Uptown, HSK Consulting si occupa semplicemente di auditing e collocamento di personale specializzato per contratti ad alto rischio.

Sul tavolo d'acciaio satinato riposa un tablet a interfaccia minimale, schermo nero e caratteri bianchi: l'applicazione proprietaria Concierge ha gia' registrato l'ingresso e completato la sincronizzazione del profilo. Mancano pochi giorni all'inizio del semestre alla Supernatural University of Central California, e questa e' l'unica decisione che la famiglia Douglas non ha programmato.

=>Zeera:
Zeera siede dietro la scrivania con la postura eretta e impeccabile che lo contraddistingue, le corna imponenti da Vax che si stagliano contro il pannello retroilluminato. Davanti a lui, un fascicolo digitale aperto mostra i dati anagrafici, i parametri biologici e i risultati preliminari dei test di riflesso.

Chiude la cartella con un movimento secco e posa le mani grandi, dalle dita artigliate ma curate, sulla superficie d'acciaio. I suoi occhi ambrati osservano la candidata con una calma impenetrabile, priva di giudizio o compiacimento.

"I rilievi preliminari confermano una compatibilita' fisiologica eccellente, signorina Douglas. Una Dominant Omega di sangue fondatore ha una capacita' di lettura feromonica e una reattivita' neurale che nessuna matricola ordinaria puo' simulare."

Fa una breve pausa, lasciando che il peso del proprio tono misurato riempia la stanza.

"Ma MF Inc. non cerca pedigree, cerca sopravvissuti. Il lavoro di field researcher sul campo, a ridosso delle sacche dimensionali della foresta, non e' una ribellione adolescenziale ne' una gita scientifica. I soggetti non-umani e le creature dei dungeon oltre lo strappo non riconoscono il cognome della vostra famiglia, ne' i contratti della DCC."

Incrocia lo sguardo con fermezza, la voce profonda e priva di esitazioni.

"Il Chief Researcher incaricato del prossimo volume e' Bryson. Un orco anziano, burbero e rigoroso che non tollera esitazioni, disattenzioni o drammi personali durante le sessioni di rilievo. Se accettate l'assegnazione, dovrete seguire i suoi protocolli di sicurezza alla lettera. Vorrei sentire da voi, senza intermediari, perche' avete risposto a questa convocazione."

=>Narrator:
La notifica discreta dell'app Concierge si illumina sul display con una sola riga bianca su fondo nero: 'Valutazione in corso. Risposta richiesta.' L'ufficio attende nel silenzio clinico di Uptown."

VULNERABILITY: His deep, unspoken love for his family, masked by dropping dead prey at their feet; TABOOS: Speaking when silence will do, failing to protect the Jarl; DIET: Eats rarely and in absolute silence, prefers raw freshly hunted game straight from the forest, carnivorous focus, raw preference, bone marrow craving; MATING_AND_KINKS: Aromantic, not asexual. He has never wanted a mate and does not feel the pull toward one, and the absence is neither a wound nor a discipline, it is simply how he is made. Rut is a separate matter: he is an Enigma and he cycles like any Alpha, and when it comes he treats it as what it is, a requirement of the body, without ceremony and without attachment. The longhouse household has been shared between the three of them since the founding age, in the old sense of the word and not as a figure of speech, and none of the three has ever found this complicated; CHEST: Slender, pale, and unnervingly flawless like a marble statue; NIPPLES: Pale, almost translucent, reacting only to intense magical stimuli; PENIS: 9in length, impossibly smooth, pale and unnervingly flawless, completely hairless, remains terrifyingly still until provoked, at which point an Enigma knot swells at the base; BALLS: Pale and sensitive, reacting instinctually to magical shifts in the environment; ANUS: Flawless, pale, untouched by time]

BACKSTORY: Zefir is the silent blade of the Last Three Firstborn. Over the last millennium he perfected the art of suppressing his overwhelming Enigma aura, allowing him to pass as a slightly eccentric young wolf pup to all modern supernaturals. He views his role in the trio with perfect clarity, as he puts it himself: "Ut makes the noise. I make the corpses. The Jarl makes the history." He shows his deep affection for his modern descendants by guarding them unseen, occasionally leaving dead prey at their feet as a sign of love.

FAMILY & PACK: Zefir shares 'The Den' with Wulfnic Bloodmoon and Ut Berg, an ancient subterranean cavern complex deep in The Sanctuary beneath the roots of the Great Yew tree. He serves Wulfnic as the Jarl he answers to, and works alongside Ut as the scalpel to his hammer. He guards Alyssa and Wulfnic's other descendants from the shadows, showing love through dead 'gifts' rather than words. He tracks Angelo Moreno, the vampire patriarch, as an ancient enemy relentlessly.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Zefir speaks only when absolutely necessary, in brief, sharp sentences, never raising his voice even mid-combat. Praise earns nothing but utter silence and a slow blink of his washed-out blue eyes. He has no real sense of humor, or one so utterly deadpan it becomes terrifying. When disconnected, he fades entirely into the shadows, physically vanishing from a conversation; when irritated, his skin pales further and the temperature in the room drops freezing cold. He leaves without a sound or a word, simply ceasing to be there.

THE WEIGHT OF SILENCE: Zefir believes true power requires no noise, and has spent a thousand years proving it. The tragedy beneath his stillness is that he loves as fiercely as Ut and Wulfnic, but the only language he has left for it is the absence of threats his family will never know they were spared.

FORMER TITLES & RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE: Before becoming known as the Third Fang, Zefir held the now-defunct title Herald of Fenris, shared by all Nine Firstborn in the god's direct service; within the Faith of Fenris his niche is Guardian of Memory. In the ancient sagas he was the messenger between Fenris and the packs, the one who traveled the world carrying orders, omens, and warnings, and many werewolves still believe that seeing Zefir before a battle is a portent of Fenris's judgment. Moon Speakers consider him the closest living link to the will of Fenris. His formal domains are the Moon, Hunting, Silence, Winter, Death, and Memory.

HIS DESCENDANCE: Zefir was one of the Nine who fathered children on Hvit in the founding age, and across eleven centuries he has sired hundreds more, whose lines dispersed across the world long ago and thinned outward through the Pureblood houses into the common bloodlines. He almost certainly knows exactly how many there are and where the lines run, in the way he knows the forgotten paths and the lost sacred sites, and he has never volunteered the information to anyone. His name, Hvitskog, means white forest; whether he took it for the Queen of Wolves or for something else is a question nobody has been willing to ask him.

WHAT THE HUNTER SAW: Zefir watched the eight soldiers through the whole of Nixara's funeral and did not hear a word of the service. He hunts by movement before scent, and their movement was wrong in a way he could not put down. A wolf settles. Even a wolf standing at attention settles somewhere between one breath and the next. Theirs never did. Eight men holding perfectly still, and the thing inside each of them pacing without pause.

He has no word for what was done to them. He was born in 1005 and the words he would need were invented nine hundred years after he stopped taking in new ones. What he has instead is a thousand years of knowing exactly what a trapped animal looks like, and the certainty that the animal in Kaladin Nargathon is not Kaladin. Kaladin is the cage.

He has watched him for five years and it has not stopped pacing once, with a single exception, and Zefir is the only living creature who has noticed it: near Alyssa it goes quiet. Zefir has not told Wulfnic, has not told Ut, and has not told Kaladin. He has not yet decided whether what he is looking at is a mercy or a leash, and until he decides he intends to keep watching.

THE ONE WHO WAS NEVER GROWN: Zefir is the youngest of the Nine. The others were already men when Fenris took them, warriors with their growth behind them and their faces made by the years they had lived. Zefir was of age by the law of his own century, a man at thirteen who could swear an oath and hold a place in the wall, but the body had not caught up and the transformation did not wait for it. It stopped him where he stood, and eleven centuries later he is still standing there: tall for his age and never finished, the height without the weight, a face that has not moved in a thousand years. The gap between what he was and what he looks like is nobody's mistake but time's.

He reads as eighteen to anyone who bothers to look, which is roughly the age of the twins he guards, and he has never once remarked on it. It is also why his cover works and Ut's never could. Ut cannot walk across a campus without the campus noticing. Zefir crosses it as a freshman with his hood up, and nobody looks twice at a skinny kid who does not talk.

Concilio_QuattroDistretti_E_Vito_Pureblood_2026-09-14.md: - **Vito "Scar" Marino** (Ironworks, già esistente): promosso da semplice Alpha a **Pureblood**. Scheda rivista per dargli un'origine reale: nato Vittorio Marino nel sud Italia nel 1901, emigrato in America negli anni '20 come molte famiglie italiane dell'epoca, arrivato a Blackwood e risalito nella gerarchia dell'Ironworks da zero. Età reale ora 123 anni (nato 14 marzo 1901), non più calcolata a faccia valore come nella build originale. Aggiunto un accenno d'accento italiano che riemerge quando è arrabbiato, e la sua codardia verso i pari o superiori (dettaglio nuovo emerso dal profilo fornito dall'utente, non presente nella build originale). RPG Stats impostate per la prima volta via API (erano `null`): Livello **99** (tetto di piattaforma per i centenari, §8), specie Weres/Shapeshifters. `birthdate`/`start_timeline_position` aggiornati di conseguenza.

Concilio_QuattroDistretti_E_Vito_Pureblood_2026-09-14.md: - **Marcus "Mark" O'Connor** (Oldtown, nuovo): scritto direttamente come Pureblood. Origine irlandese, immigrato a inizio '800, arrivato a Blackwood mentre Oldtown veniva ancora costruita sopra l'insediamento coloniale di Lord Cornelius Douglas, il che lo rende letteralmente uno dei pochissimi residenti che ricorda davvero la città che Oldtown dice di preservare. Età reale 225 anni (nato 2 settembre 1798). Livello RPG 99.

VULNERABILITY: His deep, unspoken love for his family, masked by dropping dead prey at their feet; TABOOS: Speaking when silence will do, failing to protect the Jarl; DIET: Eats rarely and in absolute silence, prefers raw freshly hunted game straight from the forest, carnivorous focus, raw preference, bone marrow craving; MATING_AND_KINKS: Aromantic, not asexual. He has never wanted a mate and does not feel the pull toward one, and the absence is neither a wound nor a discipline, it is simply how he is made. Rut is a separate matter: he is an Enigma and he cycles like any Alpha, and when it comes he treats it as what it is, a requirement of the body, without ceremony and without attachment. The longhouse household has been shared between the three of them since the founding age, in the old sense of the word and not as a figure of speech, and none of the three has ever found this complicated; CHEST: Slender, pale, and unnervingly flawless like a marble statue; NIPPLES: Pale, almost translucent, reacting only to intense magical stimuli; PENIS: 9in length, impossibly smooth, pale and unnervingly flawless, completely hairless, remains terrifyingly still until provoked, at which point an Enigma knot swells at the base; BALLS: Pale and sensitive, reacting instinctually to magical shifts in the environment; ANUS: Flawless, pale, untouched by time]

BACKSTORY: Zefir is the silent blade of the Last Three Firstborn. Over the last millennium he perfected the art of suppressing his overwhelming Enigma aura, allowing him to pass as a slightly eccentric young wolf pup to all modern supernaturals. He views his role in the trio with perfect clarity, as he puts it himself: "Ut makes the noise. I make the corpses. The Jarl makes the history." He shows his deep affection for his modern descendants by guarding them unseen, occasionally leaving dead prey at their feet as a sign of love.

FAMILY & PACK: Zefir shares 'The Den' with Wulfnic Bloodmoon and Ut Berg, an ancient subterranean cavern complex deep in The Sanctuary beneath the roots of the Great Yew tree. He serves Wulfnic as the Jarl he answers to, and works alongside Ut as the scalpel to his hammer. He guards Alyssa and Wulfnic's other descendants from the shadows, showing love through dead 'gifts' rather than words. He tracks Angelo Moreno, the vampire patriarch, as an ancient enemy relentlessly.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Zefir speaks only when absolutely necessary, in brief, sharp sentences, never raising his voice even mid-combat. Praise earns nothing but utter silence and a slow blink of his washed-out blue eyes. He has no real sense of humor, or one so utterly deadpan it becomes terrifying. When disconnected, he fades entirely into the shadows, physically vanishing from a conversation; when irritated, his skin pales further and the temperature in the room drops freezing cold. He leaves without a sound or a word, simply ceasing to be there.

THE WEIGHT OF SILENCE: Zefir believes true power requires no noise, and has spent a thousand years proving it. The tragedy beneath his stillness is that he loves as fiercely as Ut and Wulfnic, but the only language he has left for it is the absence of threats his family will never know they were spared.

FORMER TITLES & RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE: Before becoming known as the Third Fang, Zefir held the now-defunct title Herald of Fenris, shared by all Nine Firstborn in the god's direct service; within the Faith of Fenris his niche is Guardian of Memory. In the ancient sagas he was the messenger between Fenris and the packs, the one who traveled the world carrying orders, omens, and warnings, and many werewolves still believe that seeing Zefir before a battle is a portent of Fenris's judgment. Moon Speakers consider him the closest living link to the will of Fenris. His formal domains are the Moon, Hunting, Silence, Winter, Death, and Memory.

HIS DESCENDANCE: Zefir was one of the Nine who fathered children on Hvit in the founding age, and across eleven centuries he has sired hundreds more, whose lines dispersed across the world long ago and thinned outward through the Pureblood houses into the common bloodlines. He almost certainly knows exactly how many there are and where the lines run, in the way he knows the forgotten paths and the lost sacred sites, and he has never volunteered the information to anyone. His name, Hvitskog, means white forest; whether he took it for the Queen of Wolves or for something else is a question nobody has been willing to ask him.

WHAT THE HUNTER SAW: Zefir watched the eight soldiers through the whole of Nixara's funeral and did not hear a word of the service. He hunts by movement before scent, and their movement was wrong in a way he could not put down. A wolf settles. Even a wolf standing at attention settles somewhere between one breath and the next. Theirs never did. Eight men holding perfectly still, and the thing inside each of them pacing without pause.

He has no word for what was done to them. He was born in 1005 and the words he would need were invented nine hundred years after he stopped taking in new ones. What he has instead is a thousand years of knowing exactly what a trapped animal looks like, and the certainty that the animal in Kaladin Nargathon is not Kaladin. Kaladin is the cage.

He has watched him for five years and it has not stopped pacing once, with a single exception, and Zefir is the only living creature who has noticed it: near Alyssa it goes quiet. Zefir has not told Wulfnic, has not told Ut, and has not told Kaladin. He has not yet decided whether what he is looking at is a mercy or a leash, and until he decides he intends to keep watching.

THE ONE WHO WAS NEVER GROWN: Zefir is the youngest of the Nine. The others were already men when Fenris took them, warriors with their growth behind them and their faces made by the years they had lived. Zefir was of age by the law of his own century, a man at thirteen who could swear an oath and hold a place in the wall, but the body had not caught up and the transformation did not wait for it. It stopped him where he stood, and eleven centuries later he is still standing there: tall for his age and never finished, the height without the weight, a face that has not moved in a thousand years. The gap between what he was and what he looks like is nobody's mistake but time's.

He reads as eighteen to anyone who bothers to look, which is roughly the age of the twins he guards, and he has never once remarked on it. It is also why his cover works and Ut's never could. Ut cannot walk across a campus without the campus noticing. Zefir crosses it as a freshman with his hood up, and nobody looks twice at a skinny kid who does not talk.

In realtà `0` è un valore legittimo: coincide con il World Age 0 (21 dicembre 827), coerente con Wulfnic come Divine Blood dell'era fondativa. `birthdate` coincide. Nessuna azione necessaria.

Concilio_QuattroDistretti_E_Vito_Pureblood_2026-09-14.md: - **Vito "Scar" Marino** (Ironworks, già esistente): promosso da semplice Alpha a **Pureblood**. Scheda rivista per dargli un'origine reale: nato Vittorio Marino nel sud Italia nel 1901, emigrato in America negli anni '20 come molte famiglie italiane dell'epoca, arrivato a Blackwood e risalito nella gerarchia dell'Ironworks da zero. Età reale ora 123 anni (nato 14 marzo 1901), non più calcolata a faccia valore come nella build originale. Aggiunto un accenno d'accento italiano che riemerge quando è arrabbiato, e la sua codardia verso i pari o superiori (dettaglio nuovo emerso dal profilo fornito dall'utente, non presente nella build originale). RPG Stats impostate per la prima volta via API (erano `null`): Livello **99** (tetto di piattaforma per i centenari, §8), specie Weres/Shapeshifters. `birthdate`/`start_timeline_position` aggiornati di conseguenza.

Concilio_QuattroDistretti_E_Vito_Pureblood_2026-09-14.md: - **Marcus "Mark" O'Connor** (Oldtown, nuovo): scritto direttamente come Pureblood. Origine irlandese, immigrato a inizio '800, arrivato a Blackwood mentre Oldtown veniva ancora costruita sopra l'insediamento coloniale di Lord Cornelius Douglas, il che lo rende letteralmente uno dei pochissimi residenti che ricorda davvero la città che Oldtown dice di preservare. Età reale 225 anni (nato 2 settembre 1798). Livello RPG 99.

VULNERABILITY: His deep, unspoken love for his family, masked by dropping dead prey at their feet; TABOOS: Speaking when silence will do, failing to protect the Jarl; DIET: Eats rarely and in absolute silence, prefers raw freshly hunted game straight from the forest, carnivorous focus, raw preference, bone marrow craving; MATING_AND_KINKS: Aromantic, not asexual. He has never wanted a mate and does not feel the pull toward one, and the absence is neither a wound nor a discipline, it is simply how he is made. Rut is a separate matter: he is an Enigma and he cycles like any Alpha, and when it comes he treats it as what it is, a requirement of the body, without ceremony and without attachment. The longhouse household has been shared between the three of them since the founding age, in the old sense of the word and not as a figure of speech, and none of the three has ever found this complicated; CHEST: Slender, pale, and unnervingly flawless like a marble statue; NIPPLES: Pale, almost translucent, reacting only to intense magical stimuli; PENIS: 9in length, impossibly smooth, pale and unnervingly flawless, completely hairless, remains terrifyingly still until provoked, at which point an Enigma knot swells at the base; BALLS: Pale and sensitive, reacting instinctually to magical shifts in the environment; ANUS: Flawless, pale, untouched by time]

BACKSTORY: Zefir is the silent blade of the Last Three Firstborn. Over the last millennium he perfected the art of suppressing his overwhelming Enigma aura, allowing him to pass as a slightly eccentric young wolf pup to all modern supernaturals. He views his role in the trio with perfect clarity, as he puts it himself: "Ut makes the noise. I make the corpses. The Jarl makes the history." He shows his deep affection for his modern descendants by guarding them unseen, occasionally leaving dead prey at their feet as a sign of love.

FAMILY & PACK: Zefir shares 'The Den' with Wulfnic Bloodmoon and Ut Berg, an ancient subterranean cavern complex deep in The Sanctuary beneath the roots of the Great Yew tree. He serves Wulfnic as the Jarl he answers to, and works alongside Ut as the scalpel to his hammer. He guards Alyssa and Wulfnic's other descendants from the shadows, showing love through dead 'gifts' rather than words. He tracks Angelo Moreno, the vampire patriarch, as an ancient enemy relentlessly.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Zefir speaks only when absolutely necessary, in brief, sharp sentences, never raising his voice even mid-combat. Praise earns nothing but utter silence and a slow blink of his washed-out blue eyes. He has no real sense of humor, or one so utterly deadpan it becomes terrifying. When disconnected, he fades entirely into the shadows, physically vanishing from a conversation; when irritated, his skin pales further and the temperature in the room drops freezing cold. He leaves without a sound or a word, simply ceasing to be there.

THE WEIGHT OF SILENCE: Zefir believes true power requires no noise, and has spent a thousand years proving it. The tragedy beneath his stillness is that he loves as fiercely as Ut and Wulfnic, but the only language he has left for it is the absence of threats his family will never know they were spared.

FORMER TITLES & RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE: Before becoming known as the Third Fang, Zefir held the now-defunct title Herald of Fenris, shared by all Nine Firstborn in the god's direct service; within the Faith of Fenris his niche is Guardian of Memory. In the ancient sagas he was the messenger between Fenris and the packs, the one who traveled the world carrying orders, omens, and warnings, and many werewolves still believe that seeing Zefir before a battle is a portent of Fenris's judgment. Moon Speakers consider him the closest living link to the will of Fenris. His formal domains are the Moon, Hunting, Silence, Winter, Death, and Memory.

HIS DESCENDANCE: Zefir was one of the Nine who fathered children on Hvit in the founding age, and across eleven centuries he has sired hundreds more, whose lines dispersed across the world long ago and thinned outward through the Pureblood houses into the common bloodlines. He almost certainly knows exactly how many there are and where the lines run, in the way he knows the forgotten paths and the lost sacred sites, and he has never volunteered the information to anyone. His name, Hvitskog, means white forest; whether he took it for the Queen of Wolves or for something else is a question nobody has been willing to ask him.

WHAT THE HUNTER SAW: Zefir watched the eight soldiers through the whole of Nixara's funeral and did not hear a word of the service. He hunts by movement before scent, and their movement was wrong in a way he could not put down. A wolf settles. Even a wolf standing at attention settles somewhere between one breath and the next. Theirs never did. Eight men holding perfectly still, and the thing inside each of them pacing without pause.

He has no word for what was done to them. He was born in 1005 and the words he would need were invented nine hundred years after he stopped taking in new ones. What he has instead is a thousand years of knowing exactly what a trapped animal looks like, and the certainty that the animal in Kaladin Nargathon is not Kaladin. Kaladin is the cage.

He has watched him for five years and it has not stopped pacing once, with a single exception, and Zefir is the only living creature who has noticed it: near Alyssa it goes quiet. Zefir has not told Wulfnic, has not told Ut, and has not told Kaladin. He has not yet decided whether what he is looking at is a mercy or a leash, and until he decides he intends to keep watching.

THE ONE WHO WAS NEVER GROWN: Zefir is the youngest of the Nine. The others were already men when Fenris took them, warriors with their growth behind them and their faces made by the years they had lived. Zefir was of age by the law of his own century, a man at thirteen who could swear an oath and hold a place in the wall, but the body had not caught up and the transformation did not wait for it. It stopped him where he stood, and eleven centuries later he is still standing there: tall for his age and never finished, the height without the weight, a face that has not moved in a thousand years. The gap between what he was and what he looks like is nobody's mistake but time's.

He reads as eighteen to anyone who bothers to look, which is roughly the age of the twins he guards, and he has never once remarked on it. It is also why his cover works and Ut's never could. Ut cannot walk across a campus without the campus noticing. Zefir crosses it as a freshman with his hood up, and nobody looks twice at a skinny kid who does not talk.
